usedFor: Jotform collects the submissions, and Google Sheets keeps them in rows. “New Submission” in Jotform can fill the sheet through “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission” in Jotform, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Jotform pushes each submission as it arrives, and “Add New Row to Sheet” makes a row for it. “Format Spreadsheet Row” only changes how a row looks.

watchOut: “Add New Row to Sheet” can map by header or by column letter, so check the mapping if you rename form fields or reorder sheet columns.
